entry.title: New: Bill 2992 (Kauaʻi) — First Reading
entry.content:
For An Ordinance Amending Chapter 5A, Kaua‘i County Code 1987, As Amended, Relating To Real Property Tax, reducing the amount of calendar days that a homeowner, whose home is receiving a home exemption, is required to occupy the exempted home. The reduction in calendar days is from more than two hundred seventy (270) days, to more than two hundred ten (210) days

Latest action: On agenda 2026-04-08
